name: Mantis HEVC QSV (radarr)
description: Pre-transcode to HEVC 10-bit with QuickSync (hevc_qsv, preset slow). Skips HEVC/AV1 at or below 6 Mbps, HDR/Dolby Vision, and above-1080p sources. Keeps English, Hindi and native audio (adds AAC stereo when missing) and matching text subtitles. Verifies size and duration, then notifies radarr and Jellyfin.

flowPlugins.name: Skip If HDR Or Dolby Vision

inputsDB.code: module.exports = async (args) => { try { args.jobLog('Skipping: HDR or Dolby Vision video, leaving original in place'); } catch (e) {} return { outputFileObj: args.inputFileObj, outputNumber: 1, variables: args.variables }; };

module.exports = async (args) => { try { args.jobLog('Skipping: resolution above 1080p, leaving original in place'); } catch (e) {} return { outputFileObj: args.inputFileObj, outputNumber: 1, variables: args.variables }; };

module.exports = async (args) => { try { args.jobLog('Skipping: already HEVC/AV1 at or below 6 Mbps, no transcode needed'); } catch (e) {} return { outputFileObj: args.inputFileObj, outputNumber: 1, variables: args.variables }; };

module.exports = async (args) => { try { args.jobLog('Verification failed (size or duration), keeping original'); } catch (e) {} return { outputFileObj: args.inputFileObj, outputNumber: 1, variables: args.variables }; };
